p200: Miach said aloud in confusion. This made almost everyone in the store blink in confusion.
naaza4: Naaza: Asleep? How and why did he...?

p203: Sora replied with a raised eyebrow. Everyone stared at Sora with shocked looks for a short moment, before Bell looked very panicked upon hearing this.
bell3: Bell: Sora, you can't do that to a God! You just can't!
p204: Bell yelped in panic. It's practically taboo for any mortal to lay their hand on a God and deal grievous harm, lest they risk their souls for retribution when said God is dealing with their soul in the afterlife.

p205: Sora said while shrugging, before he gave an annoyed look at the God in question.
sora7: Sora: Besides, he yells too much. This guy seriously needs to learn how to use an indoor voice.
bell4b: Bell trailed off, even though he kind of agreed that the God in question does indeed yell a lot.

p206: Sora said as he knelt down do the God in question, grabbed him by the collar, and began dragging him outside to who knows where. Everyone just stared at Sora leaving the store in dumbfounded silence.
p207: Naaza commented. Miach gave a tired sigh while rubbing his forehead.
miach11: Miach: While I understand Sora's intentions to help, I didn't want him to get dragged into our problem or have Dian get mad at Sora...
miach11b: Miach muttered with a worried look.
bell5: Bell: Um...what was that about? That was Lord Dian Cecht, right?
bell5b: Bell couldn't help but ask, and wanting to change the subject.
p208: Miach simply gave a small and exhausted sigh once more.

naaza6: Naaza: It was then I ended up ruining everything...
naaza6b: Naaza jumped in, all the while looking rather bitter and depressed as she clutched onto her silver arm.

p209: When Bell examined Naaza's arm, it was indeed a silver prosthetic to replace the arm that she lost.
bell6b: Bell muttered, making the Chienthrope nod at him.
naaza8: Naaza: Yes. I received this arm from Lord Miach...after making a deal with Dian Cecht. Dian Cecht doesn't only deal with potions, but also special custom items. This arm being the example.
bell7: Bell: So that's why he showed up...
miach13: Miach: Yes. Unfortunately, due to the price to replace Naaza's arm, we ended up in a rather large debt. It's because of that debt that everyone in our Familia left. Naaza is the only one who stayed.

p211: A Familia is supposed to stick by and support each other.
p212: Even if his Familia ended up in debt, he wouldn't leave it.

p214: When Miach saw Bell's troubled look, he could only give a small chuckle.
miach14: Miach: While I certainly appreciate how much you care about the situation, please don't get so troubled on my behalf. Everyone had the right to leave, since I didn't tell them about the arm beforehand. What's done is done, and I'll simply do my best to move on.
p215: Bell stayed silent for a bit, before they heard the door open.
p216: Everyone turned their heads to see Sora walking in while dusting off his hands.
sora9b: Sora greeted everyone with a grin.

p218: Miach gave a sigh of relief, before he blinked a bit.
p220: But there are no parks in the area he is in. The nearby park could only be found a dozen blocks away.
p221: And Sora just did that in a short time frame?
p222: And what's even more boggling is that Sora wasn't even lying.
miach16: Miach: I-I see. Though Sora, you shouldn't have done that. I wouldn't want Dian to direct his anger towards you.

sora11b: Sora answered as he crossed his arms behind his head.
p223: After all, he's managed to anger Hades into turning red so many times.
p224: And each and every time he's done so, Sora managed to come out relatively unscathed.
p225: Dian Cecht is practically a harmless Shadow compared to the likes of Hades, so Sora wouldn't really worry from all of this.
p226: Miach saw that Sora truly wasn't stressing about this at all, and gave a small sigh.
sora12: Sora: So what exactly did I miss?
sora12b: Sora asked with a raised eyebrow.
bell8b: Bell started as he gave Sora a summarized version of their earlier conversation.
sora13: Sora: I see...even if that's the case, that guy shouldn't be such a jerk about it!
sora13b: Sora said with a scowl, making Miach give a wry chuckle.
miach18: Miach: While I certainly agree about his attitude, I wouldn't want you to get so worked up on my behalf, Sora.
p227: Bell glanced at Sora, seeing Sora's displeasure, and he certainly shared that sentiment.
p228: But he still wanted to calm down Sora from his anger.
bell9: Bell: If that's the case...Lord Miach, since you've helped me out lot during my start as an Adventurer, I don't mind helping you out as well.

sora14: Sora: Yeah! You've helped out Bell, so it's our turn to help you out as well! And get the chance to make that jerk eat his own words!
naaza9: Naaza: Yes, we could actually use the help...
naaza9b: Naaza immediately jumped in. She cannot afford to let this Familia go down due to her mistakes, and would do whatever it takes to help keep it afloat.
sora15: Sora: What can we do to help?
naaza10: Naaza: I was about to issue out 2 Quests to the guild. One is to collect Blue Papillon Wings, drops from a rare monster on the Seventh Floor. And the second being...
naaza10b: Naaza trailed off a bit, looking a bit hesitant on sharing this.
p230: Hearing this caused Bell to pale a bit upon hearing this.
bell10: Bell: W-Wait, aren't Bloodsaurus from the 13th floor!? But we're currently working on the 9th floor...!

p231: Sora could only blink upon hearing this.

sora21b: Sora answered with a straight face.

miach23: Miach: H-Hold on a moment. Sora, how did you get this!? This is a rather valuable and expensive item for anyone to get their hands on!

p257: It just made her confused and suspicious on Sora's motivation.

p263: Well, perhaps he should offer a reason to accept.

sora28b: Sora groaned while scratching the back of his head,.

note9: And finally, some insight onto Bete and his thoughts.
note10: Typically, in a lot of stories and crossovers, Bete tends to be one-upped by (insert character), which leads to him being severely angered and his pride being severely hurt, which will amplify his anger and jerkass attitude.
note11: However, because he fought alongside Sora, and Sora being a massive team player and nice guy, Bete isn't really antagonized outside of snark.
note12: So we get a more calmer perspective and less antagonizing relationship between them. He hates weak people, but not for shallow reasons. And Sora, despite being a Level 1, has defied the normal conventions and has proven himself to be strong and capable.
note13: Sora is someone who he approves in his ideals.
note14: But even with that, Bete can't help but feel insulted in a certain sense that a Level 1 is capable on fighting on the same grounds as him;
note15: like what he's doing falls flat to Sora, which in turn invalidates all the effort he went through.
note16: Like he's not trying hard enough to get strong. So he's driven to prove that isn't the case, and is training himself harder as a result.
note17: As a lot of people point out, a sense of rivalry (albeit one-sided) has been formed.
note18: I also wanted to use this chapter to establish how Sora's Link to All affects the people around him to a varying degree.
note19: For Shakti's case, she and Sora are already forming a bond with each other. Sora being Sora, and Shakti has some instilled sense of older sibling protection, considering how Sora reminds her of her younger sister.
note20: So Shakti would receive a substantial boost from said bond.
note21: Also, about Shakti. I honestly don't know what her stats currently are, considering the story never gave her one. However, assuming that Shakti was a Level 5 during Orario's Dark Era, that means she had plenty of time to raise her stats to a decent level.
note22: However, given that she mostly works in the city, her status must be average for a Level 5. Keep in mind that you don't need an S rank to Level Up.
note23: A majority of Adventurers have their status parameters somewhere between D and B. To Ganesha, seeing Shakti's parameters jump above the average is enough sign for a Level Up.
note24: The jump isn't as dramatic as you think compared to Bell, but still impressive all the same.
note26: The bond between Sora and Bete is quite literally miniscule. Even if Bete does respect Sora to some degree, respect doesn't necessarily mean he feels a connection to Sora.
note27: Even Sora, being All-loving-hero that he is, doesn't set up connections with everyone. Hades, Xehanort, Davy Jones, and Seifer are perfect examples of Sora disliking people.
note28: Even if Sora is thankful towards Bete for fighting alongside him, his perception of Bete is that of a rude jerk. So the growth is completely small, and that's just me being generous.
